title: Glowing lollipop
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <defs>
    <radialGradient id='candyGrad' cx='50%' cy='45%' r='55%'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#ff6b9d'/>
      <stop offset='50%' stop-color='#ff85b3'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#ff4d88'/>
    </radialGradient>
    <radialGradient id='glow' cx='50%' cy='50%' r='50%'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#ffccdd' stop-opacity='0.9'/>
      <stop offset='60%' stop-color='#ff99bb' stop-opacity='0.4'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#ff6699' stop-opacity='0'/>
    </radialGradient>
    <radialGradient id='sparkle' cx='50%' cy='50%' r='50%'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#ffffff'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#ffddee' stop-opacity='0.3'/>
    </radialGradient>
  </defs>

  <!-- Outer glow aura -->
  <circle cx='50' cy='40' r='38' fill='url(#glow)'/>

  <!-- Lollipop stick -->
  <rect x='46' y='62' width='8' height='30' rx='4' fill='#f5f0e0'/>
  <rect x='48' y='62' width='3' height='30' rx='1.5' fill='#fffdf5'/>

  <!-- Stick glow highlight -->
  <rect x='48' y='64' width='2' height='26' rx='1' fill='#ffffff' opacity='0.6'/>

  <!-- Candy base circle -->
  <circle cx='50' cy='40' r='28' fill='url(#candyGrad)'/>

  <!-- Spiral swirl - pink/coral -->
  <path d='M50 12 
           a28 28 0 0 1 0 56 
           a20 20 0 0 1 0 -40 
           a13 13 0 0 1 0 26 
           a7 7 0 0 1 0 -14 
           a2.5 2.5 0 0 1 0 5' 
        fill='none' stroke='#ff2d6f' stroke-width='4.5' stroke-linecap='round' opacity='0.85'/>

  <!-- Second swirl - lighter coral contrast -->
  <path d='M50 14 
           a26 26 0 0 0 0 52 
           a19 19 0 0 0 0 -38 
           a12 12 0 0 0 0 24 
           a6 6 0 0 0 0 -12' 
        fill='none' stroke='#ffb3cc' stroke-width='3' stroke-linecap='round' opacity='0.7'/>

  <!-- Candy rim highlight -->
  <circle cx='50' cy='40' r='27' fill='none' stroke='#ffd6e5' stroke-width='1.5' opacity='0.5'/>

  <!-- Sparkle 1 - top right -->
  <g transform='translate(72,18)'>
    <line x1='0' y1='-6' x2='0' y2='6' stroke='#ffffff' stroke-width='1.8' stroke-linecap='round'/>
    <line x1='-6' y1='0' x2='6' y2='0' stroke='#ffffff' stroke-width='1.8' stroke-linecap='round'/>
    <line x1='-3.5' y1='-3.5' x2='3.5' y2='3.5' stroke='#ffffff' stroke-width='1.2' stroke-linecap='round'/>
    <line x1='-3.5' y1='3.5' x2='3.5' y2='-3.5' stroke='#ffffff' stroke-width='1.2' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  </g>

  <!-- Sparkle 2 - left -->
  <g transform='translate(18,32)'>
    <line x1='0' y1='-4' x2='0' y2='4' stroke='#ffeeff' stroke-width='1.3' stroke-linecap='round'/>
    <line x1='-4' y1='0' x2='4' y2='0' stroke='#ffeeff' stroke-width='1.3' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  </g>

  <!-- Sparkle 3 - bottom left of candy -->
  <g transform='translate(28,66)'>
    <line x1='0' y1='-3' x2='0' y2='3' stroke='#ffddee' stroke-width='1.1' stroke-linecap='round'/>
    <line x1='-3' y1='0' x2='3' y2='0' stroke='#ffddee' stroke-width='1.1' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  </g>

  <!-- Little shine dot on candy 1 -->
  <circle cx='38' cy='28' r='3' fill='#ffffff' opacity='0.7'/>
  <circle cx='36' cy='26' r='1.5' fill='#ffffff' opacity='0.9'/>

  <!-- Little shine dot on candy 2 -->
  <circle cx='62' cy='52' r='2' fill='#ffffff' opacity='0.5'/>

  <!-- Tiny glow dots around -->
  <circle cx='15' cy='55' r='1.8' fill='#ffccdd' opacity='0.6'/>
  <circle cx='82' cy='48' r='1.5' fill='#ffccdd' opacity='0.5'/>
  <circle cx='68' cy='72' r='1.3' fill='#ffbbcc' opacity='0.4'/>
  <circle cx='30' cy='18' r='1.4' fill='#ffddee' opacity='0.5'/>
</svg>
